crossRefs.note: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he…

translations.web: ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated?’
translations.bsb: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
translations.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
translations.asv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it, he is a debtor.
